idea: Signs of a hidden water leak
title: How to Catch a Hidden Plumbing Leak Early
description: Hidden leaks inside walls or beneath subfloors can cause extensive structural damage long before water pools on your floor. Watch for unexpected spikes in your monthly water utility bill, unexplained musty odors, or faint sounds of running water when all fixtures are turned off. A quick diagnostic step is to shut off all faucets, note your main water meter reading, wait two hours without using water, and recheck the meter. If the meter reading moves or the small leak indicator dial spins, water is escaping your piping system. Prompt detection protects your home's foundation and prevents costly repairs. Contact a licensed plumber for professional acoustic or thermal leak detection.
